from solution import Extract


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Get the first element of each sublist."""
    result = Extract([[1, 2], [3, 4, 5], [6, 7, 8, 9]])
    assert result == [1, 3, 6]  # firsts: 1, 3, 6


def test_issue_single_sublist():
    """Get the first element of each sublist with one sublist."""
    result = Extract([[10, 20, 30]])
    assert result == [10]  # first of [10, 20, 30] is 10


def test_issue_empty_outer_list():
    """Get the first element of each sublist with no sublists."""
    result = Extract([])
    assert result == []  # 0 sublists -> 0 firsts


def test_issue_single_element_sublists():
    """Get the first element of each sublist of length one."""
    result = Extract([[5], [6], [7]])
    assert result == [5, 6, 7]  # firsts: 5, 6, 7


def test_issue_varying_lengths():
    """Get the first element of each sublist with varying lengths."""
    result = Extract([[1], [2, 3], [4, 5, 6, 7, 8]])
    assert result == [1, 2, 4]  # firsts: 1, 2, 4


def test_issue_string_elements():
    """Get the first element of each sublist holding strings."""
    result = Extract([["a", "b"], ["c", "d"], ["e"]])
    assert result == ["a", "c", "e"]  # firsts: "a", "c", "e"


def test_issue_mixed_element_types():
    """Get the first element of each sublist regardless of element type."""
    result = Extract([[1, "x"], [None, 2], [3.5, 4]])
    assert result == [1, None, 3.5]  # firsts: 1, None, 3.5


def test_issue_nested_list_elements():
    """Get the first element of each sublist when elements are lists."""
    result = Extract([[[1, 2], [3]], [[4], [5, 6]]])
    assert result == [[1, 2], [4]]  # firsts: [1, 2], [4]


def test_contract_order_matches_input():
    """Each sublist contributes its first element in input order."""
    result = Extract([[9, 1], [8, 2], [7, 3]])
    assert result == [9, 8, 7]  # firsts in order: 9, 8, 7


def test_contract_length_matches_input():
    """Each sublist yields one first element."""
    result = Extract([[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6], [7, 8]])
    assert len(result) == 4  # 4 sublists -> 4 firsts
